text: The sterile brightness of the glass-walled room feels impersonal at first—but the sight of scattered backpacks hints at the presence of others, a fleeting community passing through this transitory space. I sense anticipation: behind these walls, exchange and potential linger, waiting to be ignited by conversation or learning. Moving into the colorful R+D exhibit, I am struck by the vibrancy and playfulness of the display. Innovation is celebrated here; the wall proclaims a future where humans and machines coalesce. Standing before these words and tools, I feel both curious and hopeful, aware of the delicate balance they promise between creation and connection. Here, the world feels full of possibility, as though the space itself urges me to question, to invent, to belong.
